name: obsidian-syncer
description: wrapper for Headless Obsidian vault sync

scripts.docker:build: docker build --build-arg PNPM_VERSION=$(awk '$1=="pnpm"{print $2}' ../../.tool-versions) --build-arg NODE_VERSION=$(awk '$1=="node"{print $2}' ../../.tool-versions) --build-arg BUN_VERSION=$(awk '$1=="bun"{print $2}' ../../.tool-versions) -t obsidian-syncer .
